title: Medical Assistance Notice Terms: Fair Hearing Window, Continued Benefits, Renewals and Patient Pay Changes
content:
These notice-related settings are the same on all six tiers of Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage.

| Setting | Value on every tier |
|---|---|
| Fair hearing request window | 30 calendar days after the notice date |
| Appeal window that keeps the prior benefit in place after a notice reducing or ending existing eligibility | 10 calendar days after the notice |
| Renewal interval | every 12 months |
| When a redetermined patient pay applies | from the first day of the month named on the notice |
| Calendar month in which Social Security cost-of-living increases change patient pay | month 1 (January) |

**Reading the settings.**

- A fair hearing must be requested within 30 calendar days after the notice date.
- Where a notice reduces or ends eligibility the resident already has, an appeal made within 10 calendar days after that notice keeps the prior benefit in place.
- Eligibility is renewed every 12 months.
- A redetermined patient pay amount takes effect on the first day of the month the County Assistance Office notice names, not on the date the notice is issued.
- The yearly Social Security cost-of-living increase changes patient pay in January, the first calendar month.
